request.style: English, orchestral hymn, male and female duet with mixed choir, string orchestra, French horn, harp, celesta, timpani, from hushed grief to radiant hope, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth
The first heaven and the first earth had passed away
And the sea was no more
I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem
Coming down out of heaven from God
Prepared as a bride adorned for her husband

[Chorus]
Look, God's dwelling is with humanity
He will dwell with them
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes
Death will be no more
There will be no more grief or crying or pain
The former things have passed away

[Verse]
We stood beside the graveside with the flowers in our hands
We said goodbye in sorrow that our hearts could hardly stand
But a voice came from the throne across the valley of our grief
And it spoke a word of comfort to the ones who still believe

[Chorus]
Look, God's dwelling is with humanity
He will dwell with them
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes
Death will be no more
There will be no more grief or crying or pain
The former things have passed away

[Bridge]
Look, I am making all things new
These words are trustworthy and true
Look, I am making all things new
These words are trustworthy and true

[Chorus]
Look, God's dwelling is with humanity
He will dwell with them
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes
Death will be no more
There will be no more grief or crying or pain
The former things have passed away

[Outro]
He will wipe away every tear
Death will be no more
